# Mappstack

> Software projects, end to end. Mapped first, then built.

Mappstack is an Australian software services company. Clients hire it for whole software projects, end to end, new or existing, in any industry and at any size. It also rescues apps built with AI and takes over as fractional CTO. When someone else builds, it checks the work. It connects systems and moves them off legacy, and it puts AI to work with permissions, audit trails and human approval. Every system is mapped first, built from the map and checked against it, and every later change starts on the map: Map, Build, Evolve. Engagements start with a free call, then a fixed-price assessment, then fixed-scope phases approved one at a time. Mappstack is the registered business name of SY Innovations Pty Ltd (ABN 38 668 523 760). It is a services company, not a self-serve software product, and its maps model software systems, not geography.

## Pages

- [Home](https://mappstack.com/): what Mappstack does and how a project runs: Map, Build, Evolve.
- [FAQ](https://mappstack.com/faq): services, who it's for, engagements, pricing, stacks and industries, how AI is used and checked and how to start.
- [Start a Project](https://stackure.com/signup?account_id=3df5678e-9c26-4384-9c51-7ae628b7f46a): apply for a project. Enter an email to get a 1-hour link to a short application form. Every application is read and answered by email.
